holdout.unit: (vendor group, document, family) groups, sha256 hash

force.note: Tool factor from the three 17-4 PH readings; the 45 NCD 16 (P2) reading is a cross-check. Power is tangential only, so K_r cannot be fitted from it; every reading sits at h_m ≈ 4.9 µm, so neither mc nor an edge term K_te can be separated from the level. Support: one vendor (Sandvik), one tool (Dura), two materials.

toolguide_check.note: ToolGuide dynamic vs full engagement at ae ≈ 0.08–0.10·D (probe doc)

AlCrN.basis: applied: ≥ 2 vendor groups, ≥ 2 families and |t| ≥ 2; confounded with tool series (within-vendor contrasts)

Si-doped.basis: applied: ≥ 2 vendor groups, ≥ 2 families and |t| ≥ 2; confounded with tool series (within-vendor contrasts)

uncoated.basis: not applied (1.0): one vendor group, one family, |t| < 2, or no chemistry

DLC.basis: not applied (1.0): one vendor group, one family, |t| < 2, or no chemistry

unspecified.basis: not applied (1.0): one vendor group, one family, |t| < 2, or no chemistry

speed.anchor: the bucket vendor median (each vendor group counted once), = 75 % aggressiveness (user decision 2026-10-17)

diameter.basis: least absolute deviations over training rows against their bucket vendor medians; D_knee by grid (smallest worst per-band bias)

consensus_offset.basis: smallest grid value (1.000–2.000 by 0.025) bringing every band's median realized bias on the training rows to ≥ the target, with C14 capping at 1.00 × the training-bucket vendor median

thin_chip.sources: Kienzle tables stop at h = 0.05–0.06 mm (Westermann; Europa); Biró & Szalay 2016 (IJAMT 84:2735) zones h ≥ 0.1, 0.01–0.1, 0.003–0.01, < 0.003 mm; measured kc keeps rising below the edge radius (de Oliveira et al. 2015 IJMTM 89:39, AISI 1045; Soriano Gonzalez et al. 2023 Micromachines 14:313, CMSX-4); edge-force split F = Kc·A + Ke·b (Altintas, MAL review Eq. 1)

aggressiveness.status: user decision 2026-10-17 (points accepted in principle); optimize.Margins(scheme='consensus')

scale_points.source: user 2026-10-17: 75 % ≈ vendor median (1.00), 50 % default 0.92 (Speedio BT30 starting point), 100 % 1.10 (vendors' 'may increase 10–20 %', e.g. Harvey speeds-feeds page), 0 % 0.76 (vendor lower quartile; worst-flute h/D p25/median 0.76, calibration_report.json)

applies_to: C7 speed level (the tool-life target as speed: T/T_ref = scale^(−1/n))
C14 caps on SFM, fz and MRR (scale × the bucket vendor median)

C4.source: × the fatigue limit 1425 MPa, never above it: 0.88 = 0.33/0.375 at a = 0 (Schleinkofer 1996, R = −1, via Preis 2004), 1.0 at a = 1; linear

C5_margin.source: unchanged; the spindle is a hard limit

vendor_spread_check.source: vendor-group median / bucket vendor median over L1 buckets with ≥ 3 groups

sources.probes: Sandvik CoroPlus ToolGuide cutting-data screens, CoroMill Dura 1K344-0200-XC 1730 (2 mm, 4 FL), 17-4 PH at 200 and 345 HB and 45 NCD 16 at 420 HB (user screenshots 2026-10-15); docs/research/sandvik_toolguide_probes.md
sources.sandvik_mc: Sandvik Coromant 'Workpiece materials' MC table (docs/research/data/kc_mc_sources.json, SV-WEB)
sources.seco_ti: Seco/Niagara SMG table, SMG 22 (ISO S) Ti6Al-4V annealed: kc1.1 210 ksi (1448 N/mm²), mc 0.23 (docs/research/data/kc_mc_sources.json, SE-NC; Seco is the independent second source, median ratio 0.97 to Sandvik, kc_mc_survey.md §5)
sources.k_r: Kr/Kt 0.34–0.38 for carbide end mills in 45 steel (Sun, Ding, Deng, Xiong 2023, Sensors 23:8954, Table 2); Krc/Ktc 0.50 for Ti6Al4V (Li, Zhao, Li, He 2014, J. Vibroeng. 16:2657, citing Altintas, Manufacturing Automation 2nd ed.); no stainless value found
sources.k_te: Edge coefficients 12–43 N/mm (Ti6Al4V Kte 24 / Kfe 43, Altintas MAL review Table 1; 16MnCr5 28.8 N/mm, Popović et al. 2017 FME Trans. 45:4 Table 1; 1020 steel 12.25 N/mm, Salehi et al. 2018 Procedia CIRP). Sandvik's kc1 is fitted to total force, so adding them double-counts; the ToolGuide probes all sit at one h_m (4.9 µm), so they cannot separate an edge term
sources.taylor_n: n ≈ 0.25 (Tatar & Sjöberg 2020, Heliyon 6:e04217, Eq. 3, Ti-6Al-4V shoulder milling, coated carbide: ln T = 25.99 − 1.00 ln ae − 4.01 ln vc); carbide range 0.2–0.5 (Kalpakjian). Only used to trade life for speed
sources.rm_hb: Rm → HB: HB ≈ Rm/3.38 (ASTM A370 Table 3 approximate tensile strength vs hardness for steels, Rm/HB 3.33–3.42 over 226–371 HB); used only for Seco's Rm-banded rows
sources.thin_chip: Kienzle tables stop at h = 0.05–0.06 mm (Westermann; Europa); Biró & Szalay 2016 (IJAMT 84:2735) zones h ≥ 0.1, 0.01–0.1, 0.003–0.01, < 0.003 mm; measured kc keeps rising below the edge radius (de Oliveira et al. 2015 IJMTM 89:39, AISI 1045; Soriano Gonzalez et al. 2023 Micromachines 14:313, CMSX-4); edge-force split F = Kc·A + Ke·b (Altintas, MAL review Eq. 1)
sources.fatigue: Carbide fatigue / TRS: 0.33–0.42 fully reversed or 10⁶–10⁸ cycles (Schleinkofer 1996, Kursawe 2001, Brookes, Schedler via Preis 2004); 0.375 × 3.8 GPa = 1425 MPa adopted for C4 (Round 4); docs/research/carbide_and_edge_radius.md §2
